r.name: Marloes Peninsula Coastal Walk, Pembroke
r.description: Explore this beautiful heathland peninsula on the Pembrokeshire coast, surrounded by wildlife such as seals, seabirds and porpoises. This circular route takes you across farmland, along the Wales Coast Path and through the remains of Iron Age forts.

r.name: Martins Haven - The Deer Park Walk, Pembroke
r.description: Enjoy dramatic coastal scenery & spot wildlife on this short but spectacular walk around the end of the Marloes Peninsula. There’s no deer to see, but lots of seals, heather & wildflowers, spectacular rocks & see most of Pembrokeshire's islands from here.
